div.div: Grid electricity has become too expensive for normal people
Government owes massive debts (Circular Debt) to power plants
Tariffs are expected to pass Rs 34 per unit by 2025
Frequent load-shedding and power outages
Heavy reliance on expensive, imported fuels
1. The Electricity Crisis
Chinese solar panel prices crashed globally
Pakistan became a top importer (bringing in 17 GW in 2024 alone)
People are abandoning the main grid to generate their own power
Total solar capacity jumped to an estimated 55 GW by 2026
2. The Solar Boom (Started ~2024)
Homeowners don't know the exact wattage of their appliances
Vendors use complex spreadsheets to confuse customers
Installers frequently over-quote the required panel size to maximize profits
A simple, offline app that calculates exact needs in local languages
3. The Estimation Problem for Users
As rich households and factories move to solar, the grid loses its best customers
The massive costs of maintaining the national grid fall onto the few people left
Government is forced to raise prices again, pushing even more people to solar
4. The Grid's "Death Spiral"
Pakistan's Energy Transition
